title: General equation for flow through a proportional flow weir

symbols.definition: Coefficient which is assumed 0.61 for symmetrical sharp-edge weirs.
Dimension of weir usually assumed between 25 mm and 50 mm

applicability: The general equation for determining the flow through weir, Q, for a proportional flow weir.
notes: The radicand is printed as 2ag rather than 2g; retained as printed and not corrected.
No units are printed for b and H in the symbol list.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.
